get.description: This returns real time reporting data for an advertiser.

AdvertiserId.description: The advertiser's ID for the campaign.

Flights.description: You can pass an array of flights, a blank array, or not include. See [Create Flight](ref:create-flight) endpoint.

Creative.description: An object containing the attributes of the Creative which should be created.

AdTypeId.description: The ad size's ID. More info [here](https://dev.kevel.com/docs/ad-sizes).

IsActive.description: Specifies whether creative is eligible to serve.

Title.description: A short description of creative (in UI, it is called 'Friendly Name'). Max 500 characters.

ImageName.description: The file name as it is stored in our database. It is not needed to create a creative, but it will be passed back in the result view. If the string is manually entered, it will result in a null string.

Body.description: This is the body text associated with AdType 1 (in UI it's called "Text"). If AdType1 is not being used, pass an empty string: `""`.

Url.description: The click URL. Max length is 2000 characters. Must not contain leading or trailing spaces.

IsHTMLJS.description: Specifies whether to override image with HTML or JavaScript ad. If `true` = the `ScriptBody` field should have value.

ScriptBody.description: If `IsHTMLJS` = `true`, then this field needs to be filled with a HTML/JavaScript ad.

Metadata.description: Adds custom [metadata](doc:creatives#metadata-field) to your creative. Note that this should be a JSON **object** in a string, for example:  `{   ...   "Metadata": "{ \"foo\":1234 }" }`  The entire Metadata string must be url encoded to support URLs and special characters that can break the JSON object. Maximum character limit of 1000 characters.

ImageLink.description: The URL of an image hosted remotely. Use if you are serving an image file without uploading it to Kevel's CDN or calling it in the `ScriptBody`

SaveEmptyCreative.description: If set to `true`, this allows you to save or update a creative that contains no `ScriptBody` or `Metadata`. Note that `SaveEmptyCreative` is not a database field on the creative object, but is instead an option when creating or updating creatives. This means that the `SaveEmptyCreative` parameter will always be returned as `null` once a creative has been created.

IsNoTrack.description: Indicates that a creative originating from a third-party (i.e. it uses third-party ad tags) is EFF Do Not Track compliant. Can only be used if DNT is enabled for your account.

IsNetworkAd.description: Indicates that a creative originates from a third-party source (such as an ad network) that will serve multiple ads. (BETA)

TemplateId.description: If you are using a creative template, specifies which template to use. IDs can be retrieved from the Creative Template API.

TemplateValues.description: If you are using a creative template, sets the values for the fields in the creative. Fields must match the TemplateId and the object must be wrapped in a string. For example:  `"{\"ctString\":\"A string goes here\",\"ctExternalFile\":\"http://cdn.com/ad.gif\"}"`

IsActive.description: Whether ad should be eligible to serve. Defaults to `false`

ExternalMetadata.description: Object containing key/value pairs for customer's use. Max length when serialized of 512 characters.

FreqCapType.description: The enum value for how often frequency capping should occur. 1 = Hour 2 = Day 3 = Minute.

FreqCap.description: The number of times the frequency cap should occur.

FreqCapDuration.description: Specifies how often the frequency cap should occur.

DontAffectParentFreqCap.description: "Opts-out" campaign from advertiser-level frequency cap settings.

Jobs.description: Optional list of objects, each representing a `create-ads-from-products` Job. The jobs will be performed asynchronously and the resulting Ads will be added to this Flight. See [Submit Job](ref:submit-jobs) for more details.

TaskId.description: The type of task you are submitting.

Name.description: The flight name. Max length is 300 characters.

StartDateISO.description: UTC start date in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.SSSSSSS. This can also be sent in the format of YYYY-MM-DD.

PriorityId.description: The ID of the [Priority](doc:priorities). Here are the [Priority API endpoints](ref:priority).

GoalType.description: This is the metric that Kevel uses to pace the ads so it hits the desired goal by the end date.  Key follows: `1 = Impressions 2 = Percentage 3 = Click 7 = Conversion 8 = Revenue 9 = Daily Revenue  10 = Monthly Revenue`. Instructions are [here](doc:flights#goals)

Impressions.description: The goal amount - specifies the number of GoalTypes to aim for during the life of the campaign. The upper limit is 2147483647. Instructions are [here](doc:flights#goals). Note: the field is named Impressions even if Goal Type is not set to Impressions.

IsActive.description: Specifies whether campaigns should be active or inactive. Defaults to `false`.

RateType.description: The Rate value - instructions [here](doc:flights#rateprice). Key: `1 = Flat 2 = CPM 3 = CPC 4 = CPA View 5 = CPA Click 6 = CPA View & Click`.

EndDateISO.description: UTC end date in ISO 8601 format: ``YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.SSSSSSS`. You can also send in a standard date of `YYYY-MM-DD`. **Required** if `GoalType` is not `2`, `9` or `10`.

CapType.description: The cap type metric. Instructions [here](doc:flights#caps). Key: `1 = Impressions 2 = Clicks 3 = Conversions 4 = Revenue`. Do not set to `0` - if removing, set to `null`.

DailyCapAmount.description: The maximum # of `CapType` per day. Instructions [here](doc:flights#caps).

LifetimeCapAmount.description: The maximum # of `CapType` per lifetime.  Instructions [here](doc:flights#caps).

CustomTargeting.description: Zerkel string for Custom targeting. Instructions [here](https://dev.kevel.com/docs/custom-targeting). The maximum string length for `CustomTargeting` is 1000 characters.

CustomFieldsJSON.description: Sets the value of custom fields based on a custom fields schema. Must contact support before use. More info [here](doc:custom-fields).

IsFreqCap.description: Set to `true` if doing capping. If false or null, then the other Freq fields are ignored. Learn more about FC [here](https://dev.kevel.com/docs/flight-frequency-capping). If not already enabled, you'll need your account manager to enable it.

FreqCap.description: The number of times the frequency cap should occur. Cannot be 0 unless `FreqCapType` is None (0).

FreqCapDuration.description: Specifies how often the frequency cap should occur. Cannot be 0 unless `FreqCapType` is None (0).

FreqCapType.description: Specifies which unit of time you would like frequency capping to occur. Key: `1 = Hour 2 = Day 3 = Minute`.

DontAffectParentFreqCap.description: If true, opts-it out of frequency cap settings imposed at advertiser or campaign level.

IsCompanion.description: If `true`, enables companion ads. `IsCompanion` must be set to `false` when `IsNoDuplicates` is `true`, and vice versa. Learn more [here](doc:additional-display-rules#companion-ads).

IsNoDuplicates.description: If `true`, enables no duplicates. `IsCompanion` must be set to `false` when `IsNoDuplicates` is true, and vice versa.

DuplicateMode.description: Indicates which level no duplicates should be enforced on. Key follows: `1: Flight 2: Campaign 3: Advertiser 4: Creative`.

CanPassback.description: Sets whether a flight in an adChained-enabled priority can pass back to the next flight in the adChain.

PassbackSortOrder.description: Sets the order of a flight in the adChain. `PassbackSortOrder` is a transient value that can be modified by internal processes in the UI. Although the value may change, the actual sort order of flights in the adChain will remain consistent. Setting two flights to the same `PassbackSortOrder` will cause the flights to be chosen randomly. Setting `PassbackSortOrder` to `0` will cause the flight to appear as `"--"` in the UI, but the flight will still be part of the adChain. This is not recommended.

ECPMMultiplier.description: The final eCPM will be multiplied by this amount. Must be at least 0.01.

FloorECPM.description: Minimum eCPM. Must be at least 0.01.

CeilingECPM.description: Maximum eCPM. Must be at least 0.01.

DefaultECPM.description: This is the eCPM an ad starts at when the Flight begins serving. During burn-in the eCPM moves from this value towards the ad's calculated eCPM as impressions accrue. Must be at least 0.01.

ECPMBurnInImpressions.description: Impressions per creative over which the eCPM moves from the default eCPM to the calculated eCPM [1 - 2147483648].

EffectiveCPMOverride.description: Sets a manual override to a flight's CPM, e.g. so a Flat Rate flight can compete in an auction priority.

RequireStrictLocation.description: If true, the ad request needs exact longitude and latitude in order to use GeoDistance targeting settings.

TimeZone.description: Sets a [supported IANA time zone string](https://dev.kevel.com/reference/queued-reports#available-time-zone-strings-beta) to be used for the flight's daily caps, daily goals, and day parting. Note that even if a non-UTC  `TimeZone` is set, start and end dates will still be in UTC.

TargetROAS.description: For CPC auctions, a target return can be selected on ad spend (ROAS) goal and the decision engine will automatically adjust the CPC bid to try to achieve the goal set. Acceptable values are expressed as a decimal between 0.01–99.99. This is equivalent to 1%–9,999%.

AdTypeId.description: The ad size's ID. More info [here](https://dev.kevel.com/docs/ad-sizes).

IsActive.description: Specifies whether creative is eligible to serve.

Title.description: A short description of creative (in UI, it is called 'Friendly Name'). Max 500 characters.

ImageName.description: The file name as it is stored in our database. It is not needed to create a creative, but it will be passed back in the result view. If the string is manually entered, it will result in a null string.

Body.description: This is the body text associated with AdType 1 (in UI it's called "Text"). If AdType1 is not being used, pass an empty string: `""`.

Url.description: The click URL. Max length is 2000 characters. Must not contain leading or trailing spaces.

Alt.description: Alt text. The maximum length is 500 characters after HTML-encoding the value.

IsHTMLJS.description: Specifies whether to override image with HTML or JavaScript ad. If `true` = the `ScriptBody` field should have value.

ScriptBody.description: If `IsHTMLJS` = `true`, then this field needs to be filled with a HTML/JavaScript ad.

Metadata.description: Adds custom [metadata](doc:creatives#metadata-field) to your creative. Note that this should be a JSON **object** in a string, for example:  `{   ...   "Metadata": "{ \"foo\":1234 }" }`  The entire Metadata string must be url encoded to support URLs and special characters that can break the JSON object. Maximum character limit of 1000 characters.

ImageLink.description: The URL of an image hosted remotely. Use if you are serving an image file without uploading it to Kevel's CDN or calling it in the `ScriptBody`

SaveEmptyCreative.description: If set to `true`, this allows you to save or update a creative that contains no `ScriptBody` or `Metadata`. Note that `SaveEmptyCreative` is not a database field on the creative object, but is instead an option when creating or updating creatives. This means that the `SaveEmptyCreative` parameter will always be returned as `null` once a creative has been created.

IsNoTrack.description: Indicates that a creative originating from a third-party (i.e. it uses third-party ad tags) is EFF Do Not Track compliant. Can only be used if DNT is enabled for your account.

IsNetworkAd.description: Indicates that a creative originates from a third-party source (such as an ad network) that will serve multiple ads. (BETA)

TemplateId.description: If you are using a creative template, specifies which template to use. IDs can be retrieved from the Creative Template API.

TemplateValues.description: If you are using a creative template, sets the values for the fields in the creative. Fields must match the TemplateId and the object must be wrapped in a string. For example:  `"{\"ctString\":\"A string goes here\",\"ctExternalFile\":\"http://cdn.com/ad.gif\"}"`

folder.description: The folder the file is uploaded to. Use the folder your Kevel account team set up for your network. When using with Kevel Catalog, this is generally `products` or `categories`, and can end in the table ID, such as `products-103`. The maximum length is 50 characters, and spaces and `/` are replaced with hyphens.

filename.description: The name of the file that will be uploaded to the returned URL. This must include a file type extension (eg `products.ndjson.gz`). Use a `.gz` extension only when your Kevel account team has enabled compression for your network. The maximum length is 50 characters, and spaces and `/` are replaced with hyphens. Note: Kevel will automatically prepend a datetime string to the provided file name.

url.description: The signed URL to upload your file to with an HTTP PUT. It expires after 1 hour.

status.description: The URL to request the status of this upload. See [Ingest Status](ref:ingest-status).

curl --request POST \
     --url https://api.kevel.co/v1/itemdb/ingest-url \
     --header 'accept: application/json' \
     --header 'content-type: application/json' \
     --header 'X-Kevel-ApiKey: <API-KEY>' \
     --data '
{
  "folder": "products",
  "filename": "products.ndjson.gz"
}
'

# Upload a file to the URL received from the request above
curl --request PUT --upload-file products.ndjson.gz '{SIGNED_URL_RETURNED_ABOVE}'

curl '{STATUS_URL_RETURNED_ABOVE}' \
     --header 'X-Kevel-ApiKey: <API-KEY>'
